sample_unit: chatbot responses (20 parent-oriented questions x 3 replicates x 4 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM parent-oriented answers versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: All five readability indices differed between models (P < 0.001); none reached the recommended sixth-grade level. DeepSeek FRES 66.3, ChatGPT FRES 17.7.
links.quote: All five readability indices differed between models (P < 0.001); none reached the recommended sixth-grade level.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education text
links.effect: None of four LLMs reached recommended sixth-grade readability; FRES ranged from 66.3 (DeepSeek) to 17.7 (ChatGPT).
links.quote: All five readability indices differed between models (P < 0.001); none reached the recommended sixth-grade level.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM output across identical repeated queries
links.effect: Readability reproducibility across identical queries was moderate (FRES ICC 0.49-0.72).
links.quote: Readability reproducibility across identical queries was moderate (FRES ICC 0.49-0.72).

unlisted_practices: Selecting among LLMs for patient education based on readability and actionability rather than presumed clinical accuracy

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing the quality, readability, hallucination, and reproducibility of four commercial LLMs answering parent-oriented medical questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
